coverage.detail: 562 of 562 occupied cell(s) of size 7.135 were seen by at least 2 frame(s) spanning at least 20.0 degrees of view direction

limitations: every measurement here is INTERNAL CONSISTENCY. Nothing in this record was compared against an independent measurement of the object, so a ready result is not a dimensional accuracy claim and never establishes scale
watertightness is NOT required and is not measured here. A scan of one side of an object legitimately produces an open surface with real boundaries and passes
the pose gates judge the trajectory that was ACCEPTED. A pose the registration got wrong and was confident about is a pose this module measures as ordinary motion
coverage is measured over OCCUPIED cells only. Empty space nobody looked at is not counted as an unsupported surface, and this therefore says nothing about what was missed entirely

notes: Produced by running the real evaluate_readiness() and surface_evidence() and freezing the record they returned.
what: A full twelve-view orbit whose extracted surface sits on its own fused evidence.
why: The control for the readiness boundary: a record the real reader accepts, so a refusal that started firing on everything would be caught here rather than being mistaken for strictness.
